name: Meta Pixel
plain: Meta's page script that reports visits and actions on an advertiser's site back to Meta.
meaning: Sets _fbp (90 days) and _fbc (from the fbclid) cookies and sends page, button and form events, plus hashed email or phone if Advanced Matching is on. Lets Meta tie a visit to a Facebook or Instagram account.

access.revocation: Clear site data, browser privacy settings

chrome.note: Script runs in any browser, cookie lifetimes vary

edge.note: Script runs in any browser, cookie lifetimes vary

firefox.note: Script runs in any browser, cookie lifetimes vary

safari.note: Script runs in any browser, cookie lifetimes vary

ios_safari.note: Script runs in any browser, cookie lifetimes vary

chrome_android.note: Script runs in any browser, cookie lifetimes vary

samsung.note: Script runs in any browser, cookie lifetimes vary

limits.headline: Can tell Meta about your visits and actions on a site that uses the pixel
limits.user_action: Nothing. It happens when you open a page with the Meta Pixel
can: Report page views, add to cart and purchases to Meta
Link them to your Facebook or Instagram account if you are signed in
Let the advertiser show you ads on Meta apps later
cannot: Run on sites without the pixel
See what you do in other apps
Work if the pixel is blocked
Know who you are if you are not signed in to Meta, unless the site shares your email
limits.differs: Safari and Firefox limit how long and how widely the cookies work. Chrome allows them.

story.what_it_is: Meta's page script that tells Facebook and Instagram about your visits and actions on other sites.

marketing.name: Meta Pixel
marketing.pitch: Meta pitches it as a piece of code that measures ad results and builds audiences from site actions.

story.for_you: You never see it. When you view a product or fill a form on a site, the pixel tells Meta. It sets _fbp and _fbc cookies, and with Advanced Matching it sends your scrambled email. Meta can tie it to your account.
story.for_makers: Advertisers can count sales from Facebook and Instagram ads and build audiences from site visitors. Meta gets one of the richest data sets of off platform behavior. It powers lookalike audiences and retargeting.

use_cases.example: You look at a jacket on a store site. Later your Instagram feed shows that jacket.
A shop counts each purchase from an ad, and sends the order value to Meta.
A mobile game's site uses a pixel to find players like those who paid, and shows ads to them.
A marketer sees which ad, audience and picture gave the cheapest sign up.
A newsletter sees which Facebook ads bring paying readers.
A health site pixel has been criticized for sending page visits about conditions to Meta.

technical_bounds: Blocked by many tracker blockers and Safari ITP limits script cookies
Conversions API sends the same events from the server

abuse: Cross-site profile building, sensitive health or finance leaks

history.change: App tracking transparency raised pressure on pixels
Meta Pixel health data settlements and lawsuits began
